title: Woman in Rhinestone Outfit in Water
coreRelationships: The woman's face and upper body are the central focus, surrounded by the water.
The rhinestone outfit creates a shimmering texture that contrasts with the smooth water.
The fragmented text elements are scattered across the image, interacting with the background and the subject.
The collage elements of the rhinestone pattern echo the woman's attire and add visual depth.
